Name: Auto Catch
Author: MercuryVN
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod detail[/size]
[/b][size=4]*****[/size]
[size=5]This mod does NOT skip the fishing minigame, it only catches the fish automatically when they are nibbling on your rod (when the exclamation mark appear)[/size]
[size=4]*****[/size]
[size=3]I have been browsing a lot of fishing mods trying to find a mod doing what I want. And there are a lot of them, but they also come with a huge collection of options that I don't want. So I made this super duper simple mod just to make the game auto catch when something hits your rod. A[/size][size=3]ny feedback is welcome.[/size]

[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[size=3]Extract and put in the Mods folder[/size]

[size=4][b]Config
[/b][/size][size=3]Run the game with this mod at least once to generate config.json file
Options:
[list]
[*][size=3]ToggleModButton: button to toggle the mod on or off, default is the ` button (OemTilde)[/size]
[*][size=3]EnableMod: Whether the mod is on or off, default is true[/size]
[/list]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/size]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Only tested on Windows[/size]
[size=3]Have not tested if there are mods conflict[/size][size=3]
In multiplayer, a rarely occur glitch that cause player sprite appears to be fishing to other players after they are done fishing. This glitch disappear after player performs an action

[/size][b][size=4]External[/size][/b]
[size=3]Source code: [/size][url=https://github.com/MercuryVN/AutoCatch][size=3]Github[/size][/url]
